content.title: World Baseball Classic Winners: Complete list of champions
content.text: We review the history of the most important national team tournament in baseball: who has lifted the WBC trophy?Venezuela's Wilyer Abreu celebrates with teammatesLAPRESSEThe World Baseball Classic (WBC) has established itself as the pinnacle of the "King of Sports" on the international stage. Since its inception in 2006, the tournament has served as the stage where world powers such as Japan, the United States, the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico clash with their best Major League Baseball (MLB) starsTo watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoBelow is the historical list of champions:World Baseball Classic winners 2006: Japan 2009: Japan 2013: Dominican Republic 2017: United States 2023: Japan 2026: VenezuelaHonours triviaJapanese dominance: Japan is the only team to have won the tournament on more than one occasion, having reached the podium in every edition played to date.The undefeated record: The Dominican Republic (2013) is the only team in history to win the World Baseball Classic undefeated, winning all eight of its tournament encounters.Puerto Rico and the "runners-up": The Puerto Rican team has reached two consecutive finals (2013 and 2017), but in both it was left with the silver medal, falling to the Dominican Republic and the United States respectively.Final venues: To date, all World Baseball Classic finals have been played in stadiums in the United States.MLB - EnglishWorld Baseball Classic - English
